before.interpretation: Saved timestamps are not exact shutter times; the IMX708 21s gap spans the measured diagnostic write stall.

implementation.sink: One daemon writer per process handles both existing files and diagnostic logger; caller formats and enqueues only.
implementation.bounds: 256 pending records plus one active; input messages truncated after 16384 characters with explicit marker. Overflow is counted and reported when the writer resumes; diagnostics remain best effort.
implementation.lifetime: Fork resets writer and initialization lock. atexit and multiprocessing finalization attempt a bounded 0.2s drain; blocked storage cannot delay process exit indefinitely.
implementation.unchanged: Camera algorithms, scheduling, exposure/gain, config keys, media publication and SQLite policy.

tests.red: Slow diagnostic file-open held the caller before the fix; same proof returns while the sink remains stalled afterward.
tests.focused: Real temporary files, output format, exception recovery, bounded queue and shutdown, overflow notice, fork while parent lock/sink blocked, multiprocessing exit drain.

limits: Bounded best-effort diagnostics may drop records during prolonged sink failure, queue saturation or abrupt shutdown; core capture data is not queued here.
Live cadence and syscall comparison pending.
